question.prompt: The sum \(2\dfrac17 + 3\dfrac12 + 5\dfrac{1}{19}\) is between which two values?

solutions.explanation:
The whole-number parts add to \(2+3+5=10\), so the sum is
\[10\frac12+\frac17+\frac1{19}.\]
The two extra fractions are positive, making the sum greater than \(10\frac12\).

To find an upper bound, notice that \(\frac17<\frac14\) and \(\frac1{19}<\frac14\), since a larger denominator gives a smaller unit fraction. Hence
\[\frac17+\frac1{19}<\frac14+\frac14=\frac12.\]
The sum is therefore less than \(10\frac12+\frac12=11\). It lies strictly between \(10\frac12\) and \(11\), choice B.
solutions.title: Bound the fractional parts
